message.text:
q12.

Frontend hook — `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` (`useMemos`, and `useInfiniteMemos` for paginated lists; both call `memoServiceClient.listMemos`)
Client file — `web/src/connect.ts` (`memoServiceClient = createClient(MemoService, transport)`)
Proto RPC — `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (`rpc ListMemos(ListMemosRequest) returns (ListMemosResponse)`, HTTP GET `/api/v1/memos`)
Backend handler — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` (`func (s *APIV1Service) ListMemos`, line 178; builds a `store.FindMemo` and calls `s.Store.ListMemos`)
Store method — `store/memo.go` (`func (s *Store) ListMemos`, line 116; delegates to `s.driver.ListMemos`, interface declared in `store/driver.go`)
Dialect implementation — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (`func (d *DB) ListMemos`, line 54; builds the WHERE clause and SQL). Equivalents exist at `store/db/postgres/memo.go` and `store/db/mysql/memo.go`.
